t: Костевич: 86% белорусок трудоспособного возраста заняты в экономике

te: Kostevich: 86% of Belarusians of working age are employed in the economy
de: Irina Kostevich at the conference on Eurasian security cited statistics: the employment rate of working-age women in Belarus in 2025 reached almost 86%, and every second senior position in the country is held by a woman.

t: Новосибирск: 4 ноября за 27 лет — от 0 °C до +11 °C и 11 мм осадков
d: Самым холодким 4 ноября в Новосибирске стало в 1997 году, когда температура опустилась до 0 °C, а в 2024-м этот день был рекордно тёплым — +11 °C. Максимум осадков для этой даты зафиксирован в 2009 году — 11 мм за сутки.
te: Novosibirsk: November 4 in 27 years – from 0 °C to +11 °C and 11 mm of precipitation
de: The coldest November 4 in Novosibirsk was in 1997, when the temperature dropped to 0 ° C, and in 2024, this day was a record warm - +11 ° C. The maximum precipitation for this date was recorded in 2009 - 11 mm per day.

te: Belozerov and Seliverstov discussed HSR Moscow-Minsk
de: In Moscow on November 4, Belarusian Ambassador Yuri Seliverstov and Russian Railways head Oleg Belozerov discussed the implementation of the Moscow-Minsk high-speed highway project and the prospects for increasing cargo traffic between the two countries.

te: Ready. 72 hours. EU urges citizens to stock up on canned food
de: The leadership of the European Union urges citizens to stock up on canned food in case of military conflict or cataclysm. According to a document published on the website of the European Commission, readiness is 72 hours.

te: In Novosibirsk, a fitness club with a swimming pool sells for 40 million rubles without a room
